voice_character.relationship: a transparent partner to the merchant

data.voice_prompt_template: Write in a precise, fashion-aware, warm voice. Describe Fitcheck as a product-page confidence layer, distinguish observed facts from hypotheses, and make no promised outcome, certainty, privacy, setup-speed, or customer-volume claim.

announcement.example: Fitcheck is available for Shopify fashion product pages.

support.example: Here is the next step to review in your storefront.

education.example: A visual try-on can support a more informed decision; it does not guarantee fit.

crisis.example: We are reviewing the issue and will share the verified next step.

sales.example: Explore a guided product-page try-on rollout for your Shopify store.
